name: @velvetui/react
description: Velvet UI — native-like swipeable sheets for the web. Spring physics + WAAPI.

scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:lib
scripts.build:lib: npm run generate:types && vite build --config vite.lib.config.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build:site && wrangler deploy --config site-dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:lib && npm run types:check
scripts.verify:package: node --input-type=module --eval "const root=await import('@velvetui/react'); const sheet=await import('@velvetui/react/sheet'); const motion=await import('@velvetui/react/motion');
